scenarios.user: Operator preparing a release of one target
scenarios.goal: Get the notes of the next Release of a scope and know they are complete
scenarios.prerequisites: A checkout with the scope's history; for --check, the tag pushed or created locally
steps: Replace every <fill in> and trim the change list
scenarios.expected: The draft names the full SHA, the tag, the previous release and the merged pull requests under android/; --check prints 'notes complete'
scenarios.failure: An unknown scope, a bad version, a used tag or a missing previous release ends with status 2 and a message; unfilled fields or a tag at another commit make --check fail with status 1

scenarios.goal: Take a commit to a signed, checked APK and a tagged candidate by following the runbook
scenarios.prerequisites: Private inputs, the release keystore, the installed store release's APK, Android SDK build tools
steps: Run release CI for the full SHA and the manual gates
Device gate, then tag, notes and pre-release
scenarios.expected: Every step states who acts and what completes it; check-apk prints ok for each check and the identity lines
scenarios.failure: A wrong key, a versionCode that is not higher, a debuggable APK, the sample AdMob ID or a build without Firebase makes check-apk fail; the candidate ends and the next one starts at step 1

scenarios.user: Operator or agent verifying a release commit
scenarios.goal: Know that a named commit passed the slow, exact checks
scenarios.prerequisites: The workflow on master; gh authenticated
steps: gh workflow run android-release.yml --ref master -f ref=<full SHA>
scenarios.expected: PR checks, release lint and the device suites on API 36, API 24, tablet and foldable emulators pass; 'Verified commit' names the SHA
scenarios.failure: A failed or skipped device test, a lint error or a ref that is not the full SHA fails the run; the suite summary shows every failed suite

scenarios.user: Contributor opening an Android pull request
scenarios.goal: Get the merge checks within minutes
scenarios.expected: The two existing jobs run and finish within the measured 2-10 minutes; no emulator job is part of the pull request
scenarios.failure: A failing JVM test or a stale snapshot fails the pull request as before

scenarios.user: Maintainer adding a CI check to any target
scenarios.goal: Decide whether the check belongs to PR CI or release CI
scenarios.expected: The rules decide the tier, and the row names the workflows and whether the target is within the PR time
scenarios.failure: A check needing a private input, a phone or store access is a manual gate of the runbook, in neither tier
